name: DATE FUCKING OMORI CHARS
source:
Have you ever wanted to DATE FUCKING OMORI CHARS?

Well, bad news! This game isn't for you. This game was made for fun, for friends, and for people who like otome games but also laugh at them because they're so FUCKING cringe. If you’re looking for a serious, respectful, lore-accurate OMORI experience... This is NOT the place.

[From [url=https://lowpolyangel.itch.io/date-fucking-omori-chars]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你有没有想过和他妈的OMORI CHARS约会？

好吧，坏消息！这个游戏不适合你。这个游戏是为了好玩，为了朋友，为了那些喜欢乙女游戏但又嘲笑它们的人，因为它们太他妈的令人畏缩了。如果你正在寻找严肃、尊重、准确的OMORI体验……这里不适合你。

[来自[url=https://lowpolyangel.itch.io/date-fucking-omori-chars]Itch.io[/url]]
